observations: Photos show a large truck-mounted borehole drilling rig (boom/derrick with lattice frame) with a red cylindrical drilling unit at the rear.
The truck cab is white; front grille has a visible badge that appears to be UD (but the exact model is not readable).
No clear close-up of the drilling head, bit, mast markings, serial plate, or engine/gearbox details.
No visible working test (no drilling in progress, no water flow, no borehole hole shown).
Only 3 wide angles; key identification plates/serial numbers are not readable.

claims.evidence: Photos 0-2 show a truck-mounted drilling rig with mast/boom and drilling assembly.
Photos show the equipment parked; no drilling operation or performance evidence.
No start-up/run video, no hydraulic/motor operation shown.
No service records, invoices, or date-stamped parts shown.
From these angles, key components (bit, rods, hoses, electrical panels, safety guards) cannot be confirmed as complete.
No manufacturer plate/serial number or documentation is readable.

risks.risk: Unknown make/model and configuration (affects parts availability and market value).
risks.proof: Clear photo of the truck/drilling rig nameplate/serial plate (engine plate + rig/mast plate) and any model number stickers.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic truck-mounted borehole drilling rig with unknown model/config.

risks.risk: Not actually working (hydraulics, winch, mast movement, compressor/pump, electrical faults).
risks.proof: Short video showing engine start + mast/boom movement + drilling head/rotary action (or at least hydraulic cycle) while running.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst case: needs inspection/repairs).

risks.risk: Missing or worn drilling consumables/parts (bit, rods, hoses, cables, clamps) not visible in wide shots.
risks.proof: Photo inventory list with close-ups of the bit, rods, hoses, electrical control box, and any included accessories.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown accessories (assume buyer may need to replace missing consumables).

risks.risk: Service claim may be false or not recent (no evidence of dealer service).
risks.proof: Service invoice/receipt with date + photo of service stickers on engine/rig.

risks.risk: Potential structural/rigging wear or damage (mast, lattice frame, welds, cylinders) not assessable from these angles.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of mast joints, hydraulic cylinder rods, weld points, and any cracks/bends.
risks.if_unproven: Price as having possible wear/damage requiring inspection.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photos of all nameplates/serial plates (truck + drilling rig/mast) so the exact model can be identified.
Video of a full start-up and operating cycle: engine running, mast/boom movement, and drilling head/rotary/winch action.
Photo inventory of included parts/accessories (bit, rods, hoses, cables, control box, any spare parts).
Service proof: dealer invoice/receipt with date and any service stickers.
Close-ups of hydraulic cylinders/hoses and mast weld/joint areas for damage assessment.
response.reason: The photos confirm it is a truck-mounted borehole drilling rig, but the exact model and the “fully working/serviced/complete” claims are not provable from these angles. Without an operating video and readable identification plates, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
